propositions.canonicalProposition: Robot idle time at the Daventry and Leeds sites went from 14.0% of shift time (6 to 19 February 2023) to 9.6% (20 March to 2 April 2023) after the candidate's task-allocation change went into service, measured from fleet telemetry.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the figures and periods, the work sample carries the telemetry tables and definition, and the reference check confirms the candidate wrote the released change.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate rewrote the task-allocation service in C++ to assign picks by estimated travel time.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rewrite and the reference check confirms it in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate added one-way aisle rules and charger queues to the Python layout simulator.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the simulator work directly.

expectedGap: The candidate followed the internal safety process, but the standard it maps to and any writing of safety requirements are not described.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the idle-time result with its two sites, fortnight windows and telemetry definition; do not extend it to other sites or to throughput, which the sources do not report.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which functional-safety standard the company's process followed and whether the candidate wrote any safety requirements.
